chars.ELLIOT: ELLIOT: a young man in his twenties with short curly dark hair, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, black jeans and white sneakers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, inside a dim suburban house in northern California, foggy darkness outside the window. ELLIOT stands in the living room with his work bag, frozen, head turned up toward the ceiling, startled by a banging noise from upstairs.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: ELLIOT relaxes and shrugs at the bottom of a wooden staircase in the dark house, a calm half-smile, thinking it is just his roommate upstairs. Warm lamp light, upstairs hallway dark.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: ELLIOT stands in the dark hallway, his smile fading, eyebrows raised, staring at a closed bathroom door with a thin line of light under it, steam faintly seeping out. Uneasy mood.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of ELLIOT in the dark hallway, frowning with suspicion, slowly leaning forward to listen, one hand on the wall. Cold blue night light.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: ELLIOT looks down at his smartphone in the dark kitchen, the blank glowing screen lighting his worried face; no new messages. Rain-streaked window behind him.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Low angle from the bottom of a wooden staircase at night: a dark shadow of a running person on the wall upstairs, ELLIOT in the foreground turning around in shock, eyes wide.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: ELLIOT quickly squeezes himself into a bedroom wardrobe full of hanging clothes, pulling the door almost closed, terrified, breathing hard. Dark bedroom.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: View from inside the dark wardrobe through a narrow gap in the door: ELLIOT's frightened eye and face in the foreground, beyond the gap the bathroom door across the hallway is closing with light inside. Tense suspense.
